description: Five Java projects, each checked out at the commit just before a public security fix. Ground truth is derived from the fix commit (see autoaudit/bench.py). Cases whose CWE no bundled rule targets measure rule gaps (feed them to diagnose / infer-spec).

cases.name: halo
cases.summary: Backup download resolves a user-influenced filename under the backups root without checkDirectoryTraversal (MigrationServiceImpl.download).

cases.name: kkFileView
cases.summary: The file name taken from a remote preview URL may contain ../ and is used to build the local download path (WebUtils / OnlinePreviewController.onlinePreview).

cases.name: jeecg-boot
cases.summary: SQL injection through /sys/dict/queryTableData: the keyword blacklist in SqlInjectionUtil missed geohash/gtid_* and multi-line comments. The query is built by MyBatis ${} in SysDictMapper.xml; the Java-side sink is the mapper call.

cases.name: spring-cloud-function
cases.summary: The spring.cloud.function.routing-expression message header is parsed and evaluated as SpEL in a StandardEvaluationContext (RoutingFunction.functionFromExpression).

cases.name: javamelody
cases.summary: XXE: the SOAP request body is parsed by an XMLInputFactory with DTDs and external entities enabled (PayloadNameRequestWrapper.parseSoapMethodName).
